proposed.explanation: Reckless approach; discovering EIA requirements after design is advanced wastes time and money. Too late; environmental constraints must inform the design, not be addressed after construction starts. Incorrect scope; urban and suburban projects also trigger EIA and environmental restrictions depending on site conditions and project type. Architects must verify early whether a site is in a protected area or requires EIA; failure to do so can waste design time and cause costly project delays. Before design begins, confirm EIA applicability and site environmental sensitivity to avoid redesigns or project denial later.
